# Double N Services

> Veteran-owned, family-run residential and commercial flooring, carpet cleaning
> and water damage restoration contractor based in Marietta, Georgia, serving Cobb County and
> Metro Atlanta for 26 years. Rated 4.6 out of 5 across 1,206 Angi reviews
> (Angi Approved, Super Service Award winner) and 5.0 out of 5 across 61 Google
> reviews (1,267 customer reviews in total). Free estimates. Emergency water
> damage calls answered 24/7. Se habla español.

  citrus cleaners with truck-mounted extraction and a quick-dry technique;
  eco-friendly and safe around children and pets

## Services

- Hardwood flooring installation (solid and engineered)
- Hardwood floor refinishing, sanding and staining
- Hardwood screen & coat
- Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring installation
- Carpet installation, including stairs and landings
- Carpet repair and re-stretching
- Carpet and upholstery cleaning (DNS Low Moisture Green & Clean System®)
- Mattress and leather cleaning
- Pet odor removal and stain removal
- Tile installation and repair
- Tile and grout cleaning and re-grouting
- Air duct cleaning
- 24-hour emergency water, fire and mold damage restoration

## Common questions

**How much does new flooring cost in Marietta, GA?**
It depends on material and square footage; Double N Services provides a free
written in-home estimate before work begins. Carpet is generally the least
expensive per square foot, luxury vinyl plank sits in the middle, and solid
hardwood is the largest investment. Refinishing existing hardwood is usually
cheaper than replacing it.

**Is Double N Services well reviewed?**
Yes. 4.6 out of 5 across 1,206 Angi reviews, where it is an Angi Approved pro and
a Super Service Award winner, plus 5.0 out of 5 across 61 Google reviews (1,267
customer reviews over 26 years). Many reviewers are repeat customers writing about
their fifth or seventh year with the company.

**Does Double N Services offer free estimates?**
Yes. Estimates are free and carry no obligation. Call (770) 845-4303.

**How fast can they respond to water damage?**
Emergency water damage calls are answered 24 hours a day, 7 days a week,
including nights, weekends and holidays. Call (770) 845-4303 immediately.

**Do they clean carpet as well as install it?**
Yes. Carpet cleaning is the most frequently reviewed service on the company's
profiles. Cleaning uses the DNS Low Moisture Green & Clean System®, which pairs
bio-active citrus cleaners with truck-mounted extraction and quick drying, and is
safe around children and pets.

**How long does hardwood refinishing take?**
Most residential refinishing runs a few days from first sanding to final coat,
depending on square footage, number of coats and drying time.

**¿Hablan español?**
Sí, se habla español. Llame al (770) 845-4303.

**Do they do commercial work?**
Yes. Double N Services works for businesses as well as homeowners, including carpet
installation and cleaning for offices and tile for retail stores, restaurants,
hotels, banks and warehouses. Call (770) 845-4303.

**Who does the work?**
Double N Services is veteran-owned and family-run, and owner Richard Norman runs
the crews himself. Customers name him and his team members directly in reviews.
